system.description: The bearer of this grayish ivory wedge gains the ability to eat and digest anything. The bearer's teeth become as hard and sharp as adamant, able to gnaw through anything short of the Five Magical Materials, while his stomach becomes capable of digesting anything put into it, including metal and stone. This does not allow the bearer to draw nourishment from non-nourishing substances, nor does it protect against poison. Iron Jaw Bite: Speed 5, Accuracy +1, Damage +3L, Defense n/a, Rate 1, Piercing
